site.headline: Good hair starts in Thrikkakara.
site.intro: Book a haircut and styling, hair colour or bridal hair styling at Toni&Guy Hairdressing Thrikkakara.
site.story: Find us at Maymoonah Building on Kunnumpuram – Civil Station Road in Thrikkakara. Every visit starts with a conversation about your hair, your routine and the look you have in mind.
site.hero_alt: A portrait of softly waved dark hair against the green salon arch.
site.address: Maymoonah Building, Kunnumpuram – Civil Station Road, above St. Francis Sales Depot, Thrikkakara, Kakkanad, Kerala 682030

services.name: Haircut & Styling
services.description: From a fringe trim to a new silhouette, choose a cut that works with your texture and daily routine.

services.name: Hair Color & Highlights
services.description: Add dimension with face-framing hair highlights, refresh your roots or talk through a full colour change with your stylist.

services.name: Hair Spa & Treatments
services.description: Book a hair spa for dry lengths, or ask your stylist which conditioning treatment suits your texture.

services.name: Scalp & Hair Rituals
services.description: Start at the roots with a cleansing and care ritual tailored to your scalp and hair.

services.name: Bridal, Groom & Occasion Styling
services.description: Plan polished waves, an updo or a tailored finish for a wedding or special occasion.

services.name: Men’s Grooming
services.description: Choose a men’s haircut to suit your routine, from a close fade to a longer scissor cut. Add beard styling for a tidy finish.
